title: 4 immutable-law hook + exemption + staged-only
description: Wire the 4 immutable-law scripts (decorative/narrative/fail-closed/self-heal) into pre-commit hook with 3-level exemption (KALLAX_HOOK_BYPASS / CI / WIP commit). Refactor scripts to support KALLAX_STAGED_ONLY=1 mode so pre-commit only gates newly-introduced violations, not legacy.
